This version is adapted from "Sofreh: A Contemporary Approach to Classic Persian Cuisine" (Knopf, 2023), a cookbook by Nasim Alikhani and Theresa Gambacorta. Ms. Alikhani, who co-owns Sofreh, the beloved Brooklyn restaurant, with her husband Theodore Petroulas, recommends using curly mature spinach, which retains a whisper of bite.
